name: Aldeaseca (Spain)
description: Vertically divided red and white, with a white house on the red and a green sheaf of three ears of wheat on the white.
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 24 June 2006 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 127 of 3 July 2006); the flag is a rectangular flag of 2:3 formed of two equal vertical stripes, red with a white house at the hoist and white with a sheaf of three green ears at the fly.
